stories.headline: Together AI Raises $800 Million at an $8.3 Billion Valuation to Power the Open-Source AI Stack
stories.key_takeaway: Together AI raised an $800 million Series C at an $8.3 billion valuation, led by Aramco Ventures, as annual bookings crossed $1.15 billion and open-source model usage tripled industry-wide in twelve months.

pull_quote.text: Intelligence is becoming a foundational resource for the modern economy, every bit as essential as electricity, bandwidth or capital. Our mission is to ensure that intelligence is abundant, not expensive.

stories.article_excerpt: Together AI, the San Francisco startup built on making open-source AI models cheaper and faster to run, has raised $800 million at an $8.3 billion valuation.

stories.headline: Joulent Lands $1.75 Billion to Build the Power Grid the AI Boom Needs
stories.key_takeaway: National Grid Ventures is investing $1.75 billion for a 35% stake in Houston-based Joulent, marking a shift where regulated utilities become direct financial participants in AI-focused power infrastructure rather than just supplying it.

pull_quote.text: Our investment in Joulent is a disciplined, partner-led investment in contracted critical infrastructure for the AI-driven large load economy.

stories.article_excerpt: Joulent, a three-year-old Houston energy startup, just became one of the most consequential names in the AI infrastructure race - not for chips or models, but for power.

stories.headline: Neko Health Raises $700 Million to Scale AI-Powered Full-Body Preventive Scans
stories.key_takeaway: Neko Health raised a $700 million Series C led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, pushing total funding past $1 billion and valuation to roughly $7 billion, as the Stockholm preventive health-scan startup prepares its first US clinic.

pull_quote.text: This funding is a strong vote of confidence in what we set out to do when we opened our first clinic three years ago: a completely new healthcare experience designed to keep people healthy, catch problems early and help prevent disease before it even starts.

stories.article_excerpt: Neko Health, the preventive-health startup co-founded by Spotify's Daniel Ek, has raised $700 million as it prepares to open its first US clinics.

stories.headline: Chai Discovery Closes $400 Million to Push AI Deeper Into Drug Design
stories.key_takeaway: Chai Discovery raised $400 million at a $3.8 billion valuation, tripling its worth in seven months as pharma giants put its AI molecular-design models into production, signaling AI-biotech has moved from research promise to paying enterprise deployment.

pull_quote.text: AI drug discovery has moved from promise to deployment, and Chai's models are already unlocking progress for our partners, enabling them to design better molecules, move faster against difficult targets, and take on challenges that traditional discovery methods have struggled to solve.

stories.article_excerpt: Chai Discovery, a San Francisco startup that builds AI models to design new drug molecules from scratch, has raised $400 million at a $3.8 billion valuation.

stories.headline: HiDream.ai Raises $222 Million as China's Generative AI Race Keeps Drawing Big Checks
stories.key_takeaway: Beijing-based HiDream.ai closed a $222 million Series C led by state and provincial capital, pushing it past unicorn status, as China's AI sector pulls in record state-backed investment amid tightening US-China cross-border capital restrictions.

pull_quote.text: The state recognizes they can't really match what Nvidia or the rest of the world's AI giants are doing. But there is a different game that they can play. They can deploy capital into what are the most readily addressable sectors.

stories.article_excerpt: HiDream.ai, a three-year-old Beijing generative AI company, has closed a RMB 1.5 billion (about $222 million) Series C, pushing its valuation past unicorn status.

stories.headline: MiniMax Ships H3, an Omni-Modal Video Model That Generates 2K Clips With Native Audio
stories.key_takeaway: MiniMax's H3 unifies text, image, video, and audio into one generation model producing native 2K, 24fps clips up to 15 seconds with synchronized stereo audio at $0.13 per second, undercutting most rivals on price while ranking first in video editing.

pull_quote.text: Chinese AI firm MiniMax released a new video-generation model on Friday that can process text, images, video and audio, stepping up competition in a fast-growing market led by rivals ByteDance and Kuaishou.

stories.article_excerpt: MiniMax has shipped an AI video model that no longer treats sound as an afterthought, generating up to 15 seconds at native 2K with synchronized stereo audio.

stories.headline: AMD Releases Instella-MoE, a Fully Open Mixture-of-Experts LLM Trained on Its Own GPUs
stories.key_takeaway: AMD released Instella-MoE-16B-A3B, a 16B-parameter (2.8B active) Mixture-of-Experts model trained end-to-end on Instinct MI300X and MI325X GPUs, publishing weights, data, and code for every training stage.

pull_quote.text: AMD is excited to introduce Instella-MoE, a state-of-the-art fully open Mixture-of-Experts language model with 16 billion total parameters and 2.8 billion active parameters, trained from scratch on AMD Instinct MI300X and MI325X GPUs with the AMD ROCm software stack.

stories.article_excerpt: AMD has trained a competitive large language model end to end on its own silicon, then handed over nearly everything: weights, data, training code, and checkpoints.

stories.headline: Y Combinator Open-Sources QM, Its Internal Multi-Agent Harness for Running a Company
stories.key_takeaway: Y Combinator open-sourced QM, an MIT-licensed multi-agent harness it uses internally for accounting, legal, events, and engineering, signaling agentic AI's shift from demos into real company operations.

pull_quote.text: We've decided to open-source a multi-agent harness we use internally at YC. We call it QM and it's meant to be easy to customize, like Hermes or OpenClaw, but useful for a whole company.

stories.article_excerpt: Y Combinator has open-sourced QM, an internal multi-agent system that the accelerator says now touches its accounting, legal, events, and engineering work.

stories.headline: Chamath Palihapitiya's 8090 Solutions Raises $135 Million to Build Enterprise Software With AI Agent Teams
stories.key_takeaway: Chamath Palihapitiya's 8090 raised a $135 million Series A led by Salesforce Ventures and he took the CEO title, betting that value in enterprise AI now lies in governed orchestration of human-plus-agent teams rather than raw coding speed.

pull_quote.text: AI can write code. The hard part of enterprise software is keeping fifty agents and a hundred engineers changing the same complex system every week without it pulling apart.

stories.article_excerpt: Chamath Palihapitiya is stepping back into a full-time operating role and bringing $135 million with him, to build enterprise software with coordinated AI agents.

stories.headline: The Compute Deluge Is Coming: Epoch AI Projects the World's AI Chips Will Double Every Nine Months
stories.key_takeaway: Epoch AI estimates the world's roughly 20 million AI chips are doubling every nine months, putting the global fleet on pace for about 200 million chips by the end of 2028, a buildout that NYT reporting compares to the railroads and the Manhattan Project.

pull_quote.text: This is the largest scale infrastructure build-out in the history of humanity.
pull_quote.role: Co-founder, Etched (to The New York Times)

stories.article_excerpt: About 20 million AI chips now hum inside data centers worldwide, a number on pace to double roughly every nine months, according to Epoch AI.

stories.headline: UniTac Gives Robots a Unified Model for Understanding and Generating Touch
stories.key_takeaway: UniTac, from a multi-university team, is described as the first unified multimodal model for tactile understanding and generation, modeling touch as a transition from non-contact to contact via a dual-level sensor and object representation.

pull_quote.text: UniTac models the tactile process as a transition from non-contact to contact, capturing the physical interaction between sensors and objects through a dual-level representation that encodes both sensor and object attributes.

stories.article_excerpt: A new paper introduces UniTac, described as the first unified multimodal model built specifically for the tactile domain, able to both understand touch and generate it.

stories.headline: NavSpace Tests Whether AI Agents Can Actually Follow Spatial Instructions
stories.key_takeaway: NavSpace, a new ICRA 2026 benchmark of 1,228 trajectory-instruction pairs across six spatial-reasoning categories, shows that even top proprietary models score under 20% success on spatial navigation instructions, exposing a major gap in embodied AI.

pull_quote.text: Prior benchmarks mainly focus on semantic understanding but overlook systematically evaluating navigation agents' spatial perception and reasoning capabilities.

stories.article_excerpt: A new benchmark called NavSpace, accepted to ICRA 2026, found that even the best multimodal AI systems fail spatial-instruction tests more often than they pass.

stories.headline: A Sweeping Review Maps How AI Is Reshaping Medical Robotics, From Surgery to Rehab
stories.key_takeaway: A MedComm review argues AI is turning surgical and rehab robots from teleoperated tools into semi-autonomous partners, while a separate meta-analysis reports gains that are directional signals from pooled, heterogeneous studies rather than one definitive trial.

pull_quote.text: The future of medical robotics may not be the replacement of the human surgeon, but rather the creation of the AI-augmented surgeon.

stories.article_excerpt: A review in the journal MedComm argues AI has pushed robotic surgery past a threshold, with machines beginning to sense, reason, and act with limited autonomy.

stories.headline: Judge Refuses to Block Minnesota's Ban on AI 'Nudify' Apps, Handing xAI a Setback
stories.key_takeaway: A federal judge let Minnesota's first-in-the-nation ban on AI nudify apps take effect August 1, rejecting xAI's last-minute bid to block it largely because the company waited nearly three months to sue; a preliminary injunction hearing is set for August 19.

pull_quote.text: Such a delay in bringing the action and the motion suggests that harm is not immediate.
pull_quote.role: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota

stories.article_excerpt: A federal judge has refused to block Minnesota's first-in-the-nation ban on AI nudify apps, clearing the way for the law to take effect despite a challenge from xAI.

stories.headline: Justice Department Moves to Kill a Lawsuit It Says Would Hamstring American AI
stories.key_takeaway: The DOJ filed to intervene and dismiss the NAACP's Clean Air Act suit over xAI's unpermitted gas turbines in Mississippi, invoking the administration's AI executive order and national security to shield the data center's power supply.

pull_quote.text: The Department of Justice will not sit idly by while private organizations use environmental laws to undermine our national security.
pull_quote.role: Principal Deputy AAG, DOJ Environment Division

stories.article_excerpt: The Justice Department has planted itself in a Mississippi pollution fight, arguing a citizen suit against xAI threatens the federal government's entire AI buildout.
